title.en: The Fishing Pond in My Study Room

segments.summary: When Nobita is forbidden from going fishing by his mom, Doraemon pulls out a gadget that turns their room into a fishing pond.
segments.description:
Nobita, Doraemon and Shizuka meet up with Gian and Suneo. They were proud of the fish they caught and teased Nobita about not being able to catch any fish. This angered Nobita and he wanted to give fishing a go. However, when he asked his mother if he could go fishing, she said no, as she was worried he would fall into the river due to his clumsiness.

Doraemon saw how sad Nobita was and decided to help him out. He took out his Mobile Fishing Lake. This is a gadget which lets you fish whilst using a mobile pond. Doraemon opened it up in Nobitas room creating a small lake. They began to fish using special rods however Nobita struggled to catch any fish. Doraemon then took out his Hand Hook to help Nobita. This is a mechanical glove which helps you catch fish. After catching a few fish Doraemon used his Fish Spray so the fish could swim around in the air.

Whilst having fun, Nobita caught something very heavy. Using Doraemon’s help they pulled on the fishing line. They found out that the other end was attached to Gian who was fishing in the real lake. Gian got sucked into the pond causing everyone to be surprised. Doraemon quickly packed up his gadget so he could get away from Gian.

After getting over the shock, they continued to fish. Doraemon changed the gadget so the pond became an underwater world. Nobita got exited and stuck his hand in the water however fell in. Doraemon jumped in after him and used his Scuba Diving Set to help him.

However their adventure soon turned dangerous when a shark appeared and started chasing them. They swam around trying to get away, hiding behind rocks. An octopus nearby sprayed ink so they could get away. They swam through the gadget however the shark chased them. They struggled to pack up the fishing lake as the shark was chasing them. They managed to shut it just in time.

Doraemon changed the setting of the gadget so the water became a hot bath. They jumped in and enjoyed the relaxing bath. However they soon got into some more trouble. They accidentally came out of Shizuka’s bath causing her to be surprised. Doraemon and Nobita were embarrassed so quickly jumped back into the water. Their strange fishing adventure had come to an end.
